questions.text: Describe a website or app that you find useful.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a website or app that you find useful. You should say: what it is; how you found out about it; what you use it for; and explain why you find it useful.

questions.text: Do your friends use it too?
questions.say: Thank you. Do your friends use it too?

questions.text: What do people in your country mainly use the internet for?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a website or app you find useful, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all the internet in daily life. What do people in your country mainly use the internet for?

questions.text: How has the internet changed the way people shop?

questions.text: Do you think people spend too much time online?

questions.text: Can we trust the information we find on the internet?
questions.say: Now let's talk about information and privacy. Can we trust the information we find on the internet?

questions.text: Should young children be allowed to use social media?
